sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The first click starts a randomly selected answer sequence; there is no single fixed order.
Read each new clue and wait for the thirty-second click window before answering.
Three wrong answers summon seven stone attackers and reset the puzzle.
Completing the scripted sequence unlocks the passage and records a three-and-a-half-hour access marker.
